interpretation: This verifies formula implementation on a manufactured analytic field. It does not establish a solved field, a measured/validated G, crack growth, or material calibration.

coordinate_and_units.outward_normals: dimensionless unit vectors in x-y plane

field_reference_source.role: analytic manufactured field used solely to supply external displacement gradients

contour_construction.type: rotated ellipses with outward normals and physical ds weights
contour_construction.smooth_arc_quadrature: Gauss-Legendre over two arcs split at the exact negative-x branch crossing; no epsilon-shifted coordinates

sources.title: J. R. Rice, A Path Independent Integral and the Approximate Analysis of Strain Concentration by Notches and Cracks (1968)
sources.relevant_equations: Eq. (8a) gives the contour integrand; Eq. (10) gives J=(1+nu)KIII^2/E for Mode III, equal to KIII^2/(2mu).

assumptions: straight z-axis crack front
z-invariant antiplane Mode III field, u_x=u_y=0
linear isotropic elasticity with supplied positive shear modulus
closed contour around the front with outward normals
integrator_result.normal_convention: outward from the enclosed front region; positive signed area required
integrator_result.field_provenance: analytic exact Mode III field from modeiii_field_reference_20261005/field_reference.py; manufactured verification input, not solved field
